design.interpretation: Global optimum of the worst material energy bound under the exact stated ordering; not a guarantee of minimum PCG iterations or runtime.
design.floating_point_verification: Float64 tolerance tests, not interval-arithmetic certificates.
design.hg_argument: scale(C)=trace(W*C), W=(t*t.T+7*diag(1,1,1,2,2,2))/60 positive definite; material Loewner bounds therefore also bound stabilization scale ratios.

protocol: FP64 physical operator and PCG; scalar Jacobi or fixed normalized phase-based FFT; three independent processes; full warmup; six unit engineering strains; FP64 true residual <=1e-8
